name: Buttermilk (chaas)
description: Thin churned yogurt drink, salted and spiced.

ayurveda.note: Takra is milder than dahi — praised as digestive; schools call it mildly heating yet pitta-manageable.

unani.note: Chaas/ayran is the everyday summer cooler.

guna.note: Soured and cultured dairy is read as heavier than fresh milk, and traditionally avoided at night.

effects.note: Chaas is yogurt itself, churned and thinned with water, carrying the same live cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — untested directly, but not a different food from the yogurt the trials used, just a more dilute serving of it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
